pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: iwl7000: Merge Core35 driver updates This is a merge commit of all Intel patches for the Core35 driver update since commit 9172c11e132b979adc697c1255f300764943e666 and ending at commit 90f6f33e48b706181cbce3401157163dbc1b11cd. Revert "CHROMIUM: configs: Drop CFG80211 from pineview and IWL7000 from others" This reverts commit 8f1c1b16caffdd081a3a86f77f08bfe7a9ad71e2. Follow it up with `./chromeos/scripts/kernelconfig olddefconfig`. Core31 update to the iwl7000 driver pulled in an iwl7000-specific implementation of cfg80211, iwl7000_cfg80211.ko, which provides the same functionality as cfg80211.ko and cannot co-exist with it. cfg80211.ko was disabled on Intel systems. Core35 restores the iwl7000 driver to using stock cfg80211, so readd the iwl7000->cfg80211 and related dependencies, make sure iwl7000 and other wifi modules can co-exist on pineview configs.
